issue.title: Doesn't support Shelly 3EM format very well

summary.text: A test reproducing the Shelly 3EM per-phase reporting bug fails before the fix and passes after it, with no regressions found, the changed lines covered, and no breaking inputs found; the level stayed at L1 because the tests did not kill enough mutants, and the behaviour diff was inconclusive. Next, look at the mutation results and add tests that pin down how the separate emeter phase values are…
